foundation model.simple: A large model pre-trained once on very many varied series. It can forecast new series without training on them.
foundation model.example: Chronos, TimesFM and Moirai are time series foundation models.

context.simple: The past values that you give to a foundation model so it can forecast. Models have a maximum context length.
context.example: A model with context length 512 reads only the last 512 values.

LoRA.simple: A cheap way to fine-tune: train small extra matrices and keep the main weights frozen.
LoRA.example: LoRA lets you adapt a large model on one GPU.

ensemble.simple: A forecast made by combining several models, for example by averaging.
ensemble.example: Average the forecasts of a foundation model, ETS and LightGBM.

router.simple: A rule or model that chooses which forecasting model to use for each series or group.
router.example: Use model A for smooth series and model B for noisy series.
